parameters.content:
## PF Calendly Capture
Input: one Calendly webhook body (`invitee.created` or `invitee.canceled`). Writes one row per invitee to **MOCK - PF Sessions**.

- Reschedule: old row becomes `rescheduled`, new row gets `rescheduled_from`. Order of the two webhooks does not matter.
- Cancel before create: row stays `canceled`.
- Follow-up columns are never reset.
- Mock guard: in mock mode, participant emails outside aniol.moner+* are dropped.

No webhook here. A webhook wrapper is added only at go-live (DWN-6).

nodeGroups.description: For the new booking of a reschedule, marks the old invitee row as rescheduled.
